title: CodeView Scroll Fix — Review Map
description: Review map for the scroll fix (commit 4b980a9). Click each node to jump to the exact code. The fix ensures clicking a diagram node always scrolls the code editor to the highlighted range, even across different files.

meta.reviewTarget: commit 4b980a9 fix(codeview): ensure the code view scrolls to the node location on click

layers.name: The Problem
layers.description: Why the code view didn't scroll to the node location.

modules.name: The race condition
modules.description: revealRangeInCenter raced with @monaco-editor/react swapping the model + value on a file change.

layers.name: The Three Fixes
layers.description: Three coordinated changes that guarantee the reveal.

modules.name: Dual reveal pass
modules.description: Reveal immediately (same-file case) + after a 60ms delay (cross-file case where model value isn't settled yet).

elements.name: immediate revealRange()
elements.description: Works when the model is already populated (clicking another node in the same file).

elements.name: delayed revealRange()
elements.description: setTimeout 60ms — covers the cross-file case after @monaco-editor/react swaps the model.

modules.name: onDidChangeModel listener
modules.description: When the editor swaps its model (path changes), re-reveal after 50ms so the new file scrolls to the range too.

modules.name: revealRange() helper
modules.description: Safe wrapper: centers the line, try/catch guards against the model not being ready yet.

elements.name: try/catch guard
elements.description: If the model isn't ready, the delayed retry handles it instead of throwing.
